experiment: Tracking Experiment T2 -- Modern Default Policy Follow-up
honesty_statement: The hypothesis behind T2 was formed AFTER seeing EyeCU-Tracking-Val-v1.1 results. T2 must never be described as a confirmatory replication, and its outcome cannot be reported as independent validation of a hypothesis the same data suggested. It is a development experiment that narrows what is worth testing on genuinely held-out data later.
purpose: Determine whether the exact modern library-default configurations that showed strong exploratory results are legitimate production candidates.
closed_experiment_unchanged: experiments/tracking_v2/bakeoff/EXPERIMENT_RECORD.json -- production decision KEEP_LEGACY_SUPERVISION_BYTETRACK stands regardless of T2's outcome until T2 itself concludes.

LEGACY_SUPERVISION_BYTETRACK.config: supervision==0.26.1 sv.ByteTrack() with NO arguments, driven via update_with_detections, fed the accepted store (>= 0.25), production output filter applied
LEGACY_SUPERVISION_BYTETRACK.not_normalised: its effective ~0.35 new-track gate stays as production has it

excluded_candidates.ByteTrackTracker: exploratory HOTA 55.78, within noise of the legacy 55.70 and far below the other two; not worth an experiment
excluded_candidates.OCSORTTracker: exploratory HOTA 47.27, clearly worse than legacy under both profiles

configuration_equivalence_requirement: The candidate configurations must be config-for-config identical to the LIBRARY_DEFAULTS runs already observed. Equivalence is checked mechanically against the recorded effective configs in experiments/tracking_v2/bakeoff/meta/LIBRARY_DEFAULTS/<tracker>/<sequence>.json, not by reading documentation. Any difference invalidates the run.
detections_supplied: the frozen candidate evidence store, confidence >= 0.01, exactly as in the LIBRARY_DEFAULTS runs. The detector is not re-run.

predeclared_questions.A_reproducibility: Are the default CBIoU / BoTSORT HOTA gains reproducible from a clean rerun, from the same frozen detections, in a freshly created isolated environment?
predeclared_questions.B_source_of_gain: Where does the gain come from -- DetA, AssA, or both? Report the decomposition per tracker and per sequence.
predeclared_questions.C_per_match_consistency: Do they improve at least 2 of the 3 individual matches, or only the pooled COMBINED_SEQ? A pooled gain carried by one sequence is not a robust gain.
predeclared_questions.D_runtime: Do the identity gains survive a controlled END-TO-END runtime measurement -- detector plus tracker, same machine, same decoded frames, warmup declared, repeated runs, order rotated? BoTSORT measured +110.6% tracker-side in the closed experiment, so this is a real risk for it specifically.
predeclared_questions.E_invariants: Are EyeCU semantic, output and ball invariants preserved -- class 1 for every target human, role never used as the TrackEval class, no ball in human association, no duplicate id within a frame, no invalid rows?
predeclared_questions.F_cmc_contribution: Does BoTSORT's CMC materially contribute to its result? RECORDED AS A FUTURE MECHANISTIC QUESTION ONLY. Do NOT ablate CMC in T2. The production-candidate experiment must use exact defaults, and an ablation would make the candidate something other than the configuration being judged.

also_reported: per-sequence values for all three matches
unweighted macro mean as a descriptive robustness check
metrics.evaluation: pinned TrackEval 1.3.0 vendored copy, MotChallenge2DBox, DO_PREPROC False, alpha thresholds unchanged
diagnostics: ids per mean visible GT human
median and distribution of track length

runtime_requirements.scope: END-TO-END, detector plus tracker -- the closed experiment measured tracker-side only, which is not what criterion 8 asks about
runtime_requirements.forbidden: reusing the earlier contaminated +37% measurement, or substituting a tracker-side figure for an end-to-end one

no_tuning_statement: T2 changes no parameter. Both candidates run at exact trackers==2.6.0 library defaults and the baseline runs at exact production semantics. No threshold sweep, no Optuna, no grid search, no per-match configuration, no intermediate profile between LIBRARY_DEFAULTS and EYECU_SCORE_POLICY_V1, and no new score policy. If both candidates fail, the result is that both candidates fail.
adoption_criteria: TO BE PREDECLARED AND FROZEN BEFORE T2 RUNS. Spec 1.1 was written for the primary profile of the closed experiment and is not automatically inherited. Because T2 is post-hoc, its bar should be at least as strict, and the reason for any number chosen must be recorded before results exist.
validation_set_status_warning: T2 runs on EyeCU-Tracking-Val-v1.1, which is now a development / model-selection benchmark. A T2 pass is therefore not a final confirmation and must not be reported as one.
